database.stem: Our new social organizer’s personal favorites do not include jazz or classical music, but she loves listening to techno, world music, ------- rock.
database.raw_text:
Our new social organizer’s personal favorites do not include jazz or classical
music, but she loves listening to techno, world music, ------- rock.
(A) so
(B) but
(C) yet
(D) and
database.explanation:
列出几项有并列关系的语句时，在最后一项前加and，其他项
用逗号分开。文中列出了techno、world music、rock三个音乐种类，因此
要在最后一项rock前使用并列连词(D) and。
